title: Macaron
intro: Macaron moves from guarding a small circle to hoping another person will choose you freely. Kuru's success claims sit beside homesickness, grief and a reflection he cannot recognise. Jackzebra then insists on being himself and learning refusal, before offering that self as something sweet in someone else's life. The shift from taking nourishment to becoming dessert is the hinge. Independence does not remove the wish to be wanted; the ending allows that wish to appear as a hope rather than a demand.
reading: Self-protection and desire for selection; consuming becomes being offered, with guest's vulnerability preparing the shift.

revisions.editorial-41-imposter: The first-round pick becomes an unrecognisable reflection in the very next line. Public selection has not guaranteed a stable private identity. Travel then brings a wish for his own bed, and ambition is attached to loss in the line about his dead big brother. These are Kuru's lines, not Jackzebra's autobiography. They establish a distinction that the second verse develops: being valuable to an audience and feeling securely oneself are different achievements.
revisions.editorial-41-refusal: Learning to say no follows the admission that being oneself is difficult. Refusal is a practice that protects identity, rather than evidence that the speaker has no need for anybody. The ending makes that especially clear when he hopes to be somebody's first choice. He wants the ability to reject demands and the possibility of being welcomed. Those wishes can coexist without either cancelling the other.
revisions.t41-n1: Careful chewing first places him in control of what enters and nourishes him. A few lines later he is the dessert being offered to someone else's taste. That reversal makes choice mutual: he must learn to select what is good for him while accepting that another person also gets to choose. The metaphor is more than a cute self-description; it carries the verse from protection into exposure.
revisions.editorial-41-first-choice: He has explicitly allowed the other person to choose freely, so 'I hope' matters. The wish does not revoke their choice. Unlike the tests in 'Mold Prize' or the compulsory submission in 'Kneel', this ending leaves recognition outside his command. The claim to special ingredients remains confident, but repeated hoping lets the vulnerability of offering oneself stay audible.
